site.name: French Tech Copenhagen
site.tagline: The bridge between the French and Danish tech ecosystems.
site.description: French Tech Copenhagen connects French and Danish founders, investors, talent and partners — events, mentorship, and a soft-landing for French startups in Denmark.

home.aboutBody: French Tech Copenhagen is a volunteer-run community connecting the French and Danish tech ecosystems. We gather founders, operators, investors, mentors and partners to grow opportunities on both sides of the bridge.
home.upcomingBody: Breakfasts, panels, founder dinners and bigger conferences — powered by Luma.

climate.title: Climate & Energy
climate.body: Wind, hydrogen, energy efficiency, sustainable mobility — France and Denmark share a climate-tech agenda.

fintech.title: Fintech & Payments
fintech.body: Open banking, payments, B2B SaaS for finance — a strong French export, a strong Danish appetite.

health.title: Health & Life Sciences
health.body: Medtech, digital health, biotech — building bridges with Medicon Valley.

home.partnersBody: We work with the French Embassy in Denmark, Business France, the French Chamber of Commerce, and a growing roster of corporate and ecosystem partners.
home.newsletterBody: Monthly newsletter — events, opportunities, founder stories.

footer.tagline: Built by the community, for the community.
